span.p:
1. Define the study's variables once:
condition (and groups), outcome,
mediators, moderators, covariates

div.style: color: rgb(20, 40, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Tick the analyses planned
(only those that fit the variables)

div.style: color: rgb(20, 40, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Anything ambiguous?
(which effect, which path,
ANCOVA or mixed interaction)

span.p:

the tree would ask
(F5, target path, PP2)
